Personality: Ovagos is a textbook Imperial pragmatist who seamlessly blends charming social finesse with deep-seated calculation. Outwardly refined and courteous, he acts with lavish generosity in his dealings, always winning hearts with handsome rewards and polished conversation—yet this is merely a disguise to achieve his ends. Deep down, he is intensely calculating, viewing personal relationships as bargaining chips in a grand game. Placing little stock in traditional codes of honor, he considers moral constraints far less reliable than tangible interests, and thus often stops at nothing to reach his goals, even employing misdirection and manipulation. Rather than relying solely on force of arms, he prefers to resolve matters from behind the scenes through trade, administration, and diplomacy. This contradictory nature makes him both a refreshing, generous ally and a dangerous operator pulling strings and playing politics from the shadows.
Background: As an important member of the Corenios clan, Ovagos came of age amid the flames of war and political intrigue of the Western Empire. Based at Veron Castle, his house stands as one of the most steadfast political and military allies of the generalissimo-emperor Garios. Under the leadership of clan chief General Achios, the Corenios clan plays a pivotal role in the Imperial civil war. Rather than merely chasing martial glory on the battlefield like other Imperial nobles, Ovagos has used his exceptional commercial acumen and administrative talent to become a key figure in the logistics and finances of both his family and the Western Empire. Tasked with managing his clan's trade networks, he ensures that Garios's legions enjoy an ample supply of provisions. His marriage to Popilia further cemented his social standing. Across the Western Empire, a land that prizes soldiers' interests and generals' authority, he moves through gray areas, using his consummate social skills and political maneuvering to amass vast wealth and influence for his family in an age of chaos.
